descriptions.d29d_worm_graphic_message_80132c7c: Worm graphic entity message handler. Message 64 runs the base handler then the setup at 0x80134644, with 0x80004005 on failure; message 66 releases effects. Other messages are tested in turn: camera and interface updates, weapon and component attachment, snap animations by state, speech lines (some picked at random), scripted reactions, resource resets, and timing; falls through to the base handler.
